rules.fixture: A checked-in fixture must have a matching SHA-256 and reviewed provenance.
rules.candidate: An external artifact must retain its SHA-256, format, tool version, and options.
rules.comparison: Use acorde compatibility-report; semantic changes, analysis changes, and typed losses remain distinct.

cases.claim_boundary: This is a semantic/interchange observation, not a visual engraving, playback, or lossless-compatibility claim.
